discovery_selected_fixed_comparator.selection_rule: highest discovery mean Top20 hits; ties by lower mean actual rank then stable order

external_active_app_engine_v2_comparator.note: Aggregate comparator only; Q84 does not claim paired per-target comparison with the app engine.

holdout_guardrail: Q84 blind_oos is chronological and not tuned by Q84, but the same dates were already inspected by earlier SONAR research; it is not a virgin research-wide holdout.
hypothesis: If the pre-target state of the historical sequence contains useful information about which registered ranking rules are locally effective, then a causal state-analog ensemble that weights rules by their performance on prior targets with similar flow states should outperform the equal-weight ensemble and the discovery-selected fixed rule on validation and blind OOS mean hits. Different rules may also alternate across high/low turbulence regimes.
next_action: Inspect validation report; then freeze a separate Q84 shadow only before a future target draw and accumulate at least 200 complete prospective paired cases.
oracle_guardrail: The per-target oracle chooses a rule after seeing the target; it is retrospective-only and excluded from all inferential tests.
paired_bootstrap_inference_note: These paired block-bootstrap p-values and intervals are descriptive comparisons; they are not part of the 1,152-test Holm family and must not be treated as adjusted significance.
promotion_guardrail: No automatic promotion. Prospective shadow evidence and human review remain required.

registered_test_family.null: conditional Hypergeometric(40, 5, k) per target; continuity-corrected normal screen; one global Holm family

relationship_method.amendment_reason: The initial any-unique-hit rule was too permissive and labelled almost every pair complementary; v2 requires measurable paired-miss conditional lift.
relationship_method.complementarity_rule: at least 30 paired targets where the counterpart has <=2 Top20 hits; the candidate must average >=2.5 Top20 hits and exceed its own full-period mean by >=0.10 on those targets

walk_forward.adaptive_memory_rule: current target enters analog memory only after its forecast and outcome have been scored
